blocks.content: The essence of recent administrative reforms lies in shifting from rule-based governance to role-based civil service delivery.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Transition from traditional bureaucratic models to citizen-centric, technology-driven governance paradigms.
Emphasis on 'Minimum Government, Maximum Governance' through deregulation and process simplification.
Integration of digital public infrastructure (DPI) to enhance transparency, efficiency, and last-mile service delivery.
Focus on performance-based evaluation and capacity building via initiatives like Mission Karmayogi.
Frequently tested on the recommendations of administrative reforms frameworks and modern civil service initiatives.
High probability of questions regarding the role of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in administrative efficiency.
Focus on 'Mission Karmayogi' and the National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB).
